query: Off the Record Nessa puts her quill down, says "off the record", and it goes still. "Here's the real trick of interviews," she says. "Ask the question they want to answer. And then this." She says a word, and you find yourself telling her the truth about your exams. "That's Candour. Want it?" Learn it from her She practises on you until you've told her three embarrassing things, then lets you practise on her. She tells you one true thing, quietly, and asks you never to print it. You won't. Ask it on the record She laughs, picks up the quill and interviews you about why you won't learn it. It runs on page four. "Another night," she says. "Off the record."
